caption: Paid in full (Color Belt, as picture 03b drew it): the school, what kind of receipt, the section's facts, every payment with how it was paid, then Total due · Paid to date · Balance $0 · paid in full, both schools' street and phone, and who printed it. Close has the first focus; Print or save as PDF is the one blue button.

Several payments, a refund and a balance (Black Belt): a refund is a line of its own with a minus (“−$50”), the totals add up, and the section can add a word to the balance (“next due May 29”). Money is written as the shared rule says (v1.026).
While it loads (a section that reads the receipt from the database, as Black Belt does): a gray placeholder page, and Print or save as PDF in the gray unavailable look until the receipt is there.
If it can't load: the shared amber bar with Retry takes the page's place, as Black Belt's does today, and stays until it works or the box closes (v1.004). Print stays gray.
Hide private details on (v0.506): no amounts on a screen others can see — one gray line instead of the page, and no Print button.
The printed page (US Letter, as Black Belt prints it today): black on white, the school at the top, the footer at the foot of the page. The same on every device — drawn once.
